Class MacroeconomicMetricsHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.metrics.MacroeconomicMetricsHelper
public final class MacroeconomicMetricsHelper extends Object

MacroeconomicMetricsHelper

Calculates long-run economic history and macro-cliodynamic indices (Ricardian land rent, currency debasement, real wages, sovereign debt burdens, trade volumes, metal smelting per capita, and shipping freight costs).

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • getCurrencyDebasement

      public double getCurrencyDebasement()
      Evaluates silver coinage purity (%) based on metallurgical minting capital and state fiscal stress (Butcher & Ponting 2014) using continuous smooth activation.

    • getRealUnskilledWageIndex

      public double getRealUnskilledWageIndex()
      Evaluates Robert C. Allen (2001) Real Unskilled Worker Purchasing Power (Welfare Ratio Index, $100 = \text{Subsistence}$).
      Returns:
      real unskilled wage index

    • getSovereignDebtBurdenPct

      public double getSovereignDebtBurdenPct()
      Evaluates Reinhart & Rogoff (2009) Sovereign Debt Burden (% of GWP).
      Returns:
      sovereign debt burden in $[0.0, 250.0]$ %

    • getGlobalTradeVolumeIndex

      public double getGlobalTradeVolumeIndex()
      Evaluates Federico & Tena-Junguito (2017) Global Trade Volume Index ($100 = 1913\text{ Level}$). Couples the maritime shipping conductance baseline with active oceanic trade corridors from TradeNetworkRouter so that domestic inland fluvial freight (e.g. Yangtze / Grand Canal) does not inflate international trans-oceanic trade.
      Returns:
      global trade volume index

    • getInlandFluvialFreightVolume

      public double getInlandFluvialFreightVolume()
      Evaluates domestic inland fluvial and canal freight transport volume index, combining physical inland waterway capacity with active continental/fluvial corridors from TradeNetworkRouter.
      Returns:
      inland fluvial freight index
